sentences.en: Do you enjoy life?
sentences.zh: 你享受生活吗？

sentences.en: Do your parents always ask you to do housework?
sentences.zh: 你的父母总是让你做家务吗？

sentences.en: Does your teacher give you homework every day?
sentences.zh: 你的老师每天都留作业吗？

sentences.en: Life is sometimes difficult because there are lots of things to do.
sentences.zh: 生活有时很难，因为有很多事情要做。

sentences.en: It's great to be busy, but it's important to look after yourself and have fun, too.
sentences.zh: 忙碌很好，但照顾好自己、也玩得开心同样重要。

sentences.en: We all need to think about ourselves and do things we like, whether it is playing an instrument or taking photos.
sentences.zh: 我们都需要为自己想一想，做自己喜欢的事，不管是演奏乐器还是拍照。

sentences.en: But we also need to do things that keep us healthy and happy.
sentences.zh: 但我们也需要做一些让自己健康和快乐的事。

sentences.en: Here's our quiz.
sentences.zh: 下面是我们的小测验。

sentences.en: Try it and find out: do you have lots of fun?
sentences.zh: 试试看，找出答案：你是不是玩得很开心？

sentences.en: Do you laugh a lot?
sentences.zh: 你经常笑吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I laugh all the time.
sentences.zh: 是的，我总是笑。

sentences.en: I only laugh when I'm happy.
sentences.zh: 我只在开心的时候才笑。

sentences.en: My best friend says I don't laugh very often.
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友说我不常笑。

sentences.en: How many hobbies do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有多少个爱好？

sentences.en: I have lots of hobbies.
sentences.zh: 我有很多爱好。

sentences.en: One.
sentences.zh: 一个。

sentences.en: I don't have any hobbies.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何爱好。

sentences.en: When do you listen to music?
sentences.zh: 你什么时候听音乐？

sentences.en: In the morning, afternoon and evening.
sentences.zh: 早上、下午和晚上。

sentences.en: I only listen to music when I have time.
sentences.zh: 我只有在有时间的时候才听音乐。

sentences.en: I never listen to music.
sentences.zh: 我从不听音乐。

sentences.en: I don't have time.
sentences.zh: 我没有时间。

sentences.en: How many hours do you sleep a night?
sentences.zh: 你每晚睡几个小时？

sentences.en: 9-10 hours.
About 8 hours.
sentences.zh: 大约 8 小时。

sentences.en: Less than 8 hours.
sentences.zh: 少于 8 小时。

sentences.en: Do you like doing exercise?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢运动吗？

sentences.en: Yes, exercise is fun.
sentences.zh: 喜欢，运动很有趣。

sentences.en: Some exercise is OK, but not everything.
sentences.zh: 有些运动还可以，但不是所有运动都喜欢。

sentences.en: I don't like exercise at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不喜欢运动。

sentences.en: Do you like word and number puzzles?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢文字游戏和数字游戏吗？

sentences.en: I like puzzles a lot.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢智力游戏。

sentences.en: Word puzzles are OK, but number puzzles are boring.
sentences.zh: 文字游戏还可以，但数字游戏很无聊。

sentences.en: No, I don't like puzzles at all.
sentences.zh: 不，我一点也不喜欢智力游戏。

sentences.en: Which of these activities do you do most?
sentences.zh: 这些活动里你最常做哪一项？

sentences.en: Spend time with friends and family.
sentences.zh: 花时间和朋友、家人在一起。

sentences.en: Message friends online or on my phone.
sentences.zh: 在网上或用手机给朋友发消息。

sentences.en: Watch TV or play games on my phone.
sentences.zh: 看电视或用手机玩游戏。

sentences.en: Your score.
sentences.zh: 你的得分。

sentences.en: Mostly As: Wow! You know how to have fun and enjoy life.
sentences.zh: 大多数选 A：哇！你懂得怎样玩得开心、享受生活。

sentences.en: Mostly Bs: Hmm, OK, but can you do more? Try and find more time for yourself.
sentences.zh: 大多数选 B：嗯，好吧，不过你能做得更多吗？试着为自己多找点时间。

sentences.en: Mostly Cs: Try and find more ways to have more fun.
sentences.zh: 大多数选 C：试着找更多方法，让自己玩得更开心。
